$comment: How the Kaṭha witnesses and commentaries line up with the edition's records (adhyāya.vallī.mantra). G and V are collated mantra by mantra; Madhva's text vallī by vallī (scope 'valli'), because it groups verses differently. 'analysed' lists the vallīs whose analysis is published and required by check.py (the others show the verified text, marked 'analysis in preparation').

notes.commentaries: Rāmānuja wrote no commentary on the Kaṭha; the Viśiṣṭādvaita commentary used is Raṅgarāmānuja’s Prakāśikā, from the 1948 Tirupati edition (OCR text, whose last pages are reported missing). Purāṇic and other verses that Madhva cites are reported as cited by him; they were not checked against editions of those works. Modern commentaries in the same corpus (Vaṅgīpura Vāsudeva; the 45th Ahobila yati) are not used.
notes.corrections: The corrections restore readings the base file has mistyped or spaced wrongly; each is confirmed by the other witnesses, and none adopts a variant reading.
notes.rights: No modern translation was copied. GRETIL’s text follows Olivelle (1998) and is used only as a witness, its differences listed; GRETIL marks its files ‘for reference purposes only’. The padaccheda, word tables, translations, explanations, commentary prose and studies are original to this edition, prepared for PaddySpeaks.

madhva.name: Madhva
madhva.work: Kāṭhakopaniṣad-bhāṣya (his own text; the later sub-commentaries are not used)

rangaramanuja.name: Raṅgarāmānuja
rangaramanuja.$note: Raṅgarāmānuja's text has an extra mantra after 1.1.18 («यो वा एतां ब्रह्मजज्ञात्मभूतां चितिं…», which he notes some manuscripts lack), so his keys in vallī 1.1 run one ahead from there; his comment on 1.1.29 ends his key 1.1.29.
